summary: First test run of Guardian Health & Angel MVP. Backend: 16/16 pytest cases pass across public root, invalid session, auth-gating on all protected endpoints, /auth/me, /me/prefs, emergency-profile CRUD + public QR, waitlist CRUD + scan, fall-event, AI translate (Claude Sonnet 5 via Emergent LLM), and Vault upload/list/download/delete via Emergent Object Storage. Fixed one blocking bug: duplicate GET /api/auth/me route in server.py where the first definition returned 500 'wrong', shadowing the real handler. Frontend login screen renders correctly on mobile viewport (375x667) with all required testIDs and reactive language switching.
action_items: None blocking. Recommend main agent add rate limiting to /api/ai/translate and /api/vault/documents in future to prevent abuse.
Consider extracting the get_current_user dependency into `Depends()` instead of repeating manual Header extraction for cleaner code.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: server.py had two @api.get('/auth/me') handlers (lines 200-203 and 205-208). The first raised HTTPException(500,'wrong') and was matched first by FastAPI. Removed the dead stub; /auth/me now works end-to-end.
server.py is 519 lines and starting to grow — consider splitting routes/models into modules once feature count grows.
Auth extraction is copy-pasted across ~10 endpoints via Header(None). Recommend FastAPI Depends(get_current_user) to DRY.
seed_data_creation: Test user + session created directly in MongoDB (users, user_sessions) with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up in fixture teardown. See backend_test.py `seed` fixture.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests are in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse. Auth is Emergent Google OAuth so full sign-in cannot be automated; seed a Mongo session token as done in the seed fixture. AI translate hits Claude Sonnet 5 via emergentintegrations — allow up to ~30s per call. Vault uses Emergent Object Storage (STORAGE_BASE from INTEGRATION_PROXY_URL, /objstore/api/v1/storage) and works end-to-end. Waitlist scan is intentionally simulated (35% hit rate) — do not treat as bug.
rca_of_issue: Duplicate route registration bug: FastAPI keeps the first-registered handler for a given (method,path). server.py defined GET /auth/me twice — first as a stub `auth_me(user=None)` that raised HTTPException(500,'wrong'), then the real `me(authorization=...)`. All authenticated /auth/me calls returned 500. Reproduction: `curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <valid_token>' /api/auth/me` → 500 {'detail':'wrong'}. Mitigation: removed the stub function; only the real handler remains. All 16 tests now pass.
